description: Search Hugging Face datasets and GitHub repos for a plain-English topic, then sweep the 12-expert atlas for breadth. Returns deduplicated HarvestItem[]. Works with no tokens (public rate limits apply).

gh_token.description: Optional GitHub token for higher rate limits. Falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

hf_token.description: Optional Hugging Face token for higher rate limits. Falls back to the HF_TOKEN env var.

topic.description: Plain-English topic, e.g. 'image classification' or 'speech recognition'.

name: harvest.search
